claim: Piesport sits on the left (Eifel-side) Mosel bank; the right-bank district Niederemmel — formed from Müstert, Emmel and Reinsport — holds Bahnhofstraße and is connected to Piesport-proper by a single Mosel bridge.
quote: The Piesport district is on the left (Eifel-side) river bank … Müstert, Emmel, and Reinsport districts grew together over centuries and formed the independent municipality of Niederemmel until the 1969 administrative reform.

claim: TripAdvisor lists 17 lodging properties in Piesport; the top-ranked are Schanz Hotel, Karthaeuserhof, Moselblick, Moselloreley, Lehnert-Veit, Alt Piesport, Alt Reinsport, and Weinhaus Piesporter Goldtröpfchen.
quote: Schanz. Hotel 4.2/5 (55) … Moselblick 4.2/5 (44) … Moselloreley 4.5/5 (39) … Weingut Lehnert-Veit 3.6/5 (17) … Hotel Alt Piesport 3.0/5 (8) … Alt Reinsport Pension 5.0/5 (3) … Weinhaus Piesporter Goldtröpfchen 4.5/5 (62).
